title: 第1528章 背叛者第1527章 太孙
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
随着顶级大势力都纷纷表态，其他人目光都望向那些还没有表态的域外势力。
光明神庭和天命神庭沉默不语，并没有立刻表明自己的态度。
因为他们相比于太白神庭，鲲虚神庭等情况要好上太多，大夏的手目前还伸不到南北天下，所以大家的威胁目前影响不到他们。
因此他们不像太白神庭，鲲虚神庭那般着急。
“域外通道之事，不能只有第一祖地本土说了算，而且我们跨界多少人也是我们自己的事，本土势力不应管太多！”
看着众人目光都聚焦在他们身上，天命神庭的天光皇子沉声开口，表明了天命神庭的态度。
虽然他们与其他神庭以及其他域外势力有很大矛盾，但在这第一祖地中，从整体上他们利益是一致的。
唇寒齿亡的道理他们自然懂。
“我光明神庭与天命神庭一样态度，有些事还是可以坐下来继续谈，直接关闭通道，还是有些不合适。”
伽灵公主也代表光明神庭开口说道。
这些天，大厦等本土势力与他们有过接触，甚至尝试游说他们帮助本土势力。
理由是：
一旦中原天下，九州天下以及神话天下的域外通道关闭，那么太白神庭，太初圣地等域外大势力在第一祖地的势力将会无限被削弱，而此消彼涨，
到时候远在南北天下，自主掌控域外通道的光明神庭和天命神庭的实力将会进一步提升。
这对光明神庭和天命神庭是有利的。
这也是为什么光明神庭和天命神庭一开始并没有表态的原因。
但显然，现如今这两大神庭已经做好了决定，他们没有为了短期的利益，背叛域外阵营。
伽灵公主精致美丽的脸上一脸严肃。
她们神庭中自然也有智谋超群之人，目光非常长远，伽灵公主耳边响起那理性的分析声音：
“那三大天下通道关闭，短期确实有利于我们光明神庭，但从长期看，这对我们光明神庭绝不是好事，目前我们的主要矛盾是与第一祖地的本土势力的矛盾，而我们和其他神庭等势力只是次要矛盾，现如今我们要是答应大夏，那么便弄错了主次矛盾，未来绝对会吃大亏……”

光明神庭和天命神庭弄清楚主次矛盾后，顿时便做出了正确的决策。
大夏这边有人目光深邃，看着这两张神庭，最终还是站在了他们的对立面并没有神情动容，因为拉拢这两大神庭，本就是一步闲棋，如果这两大神庭真的中招的话，那么等他们解决好这边的事，下一步便直接吸进南北天下，解决掉这两大愚蠢的神庭。
两大神庭表态之后，众人目光又看向玄霄。
这位现如今在南北天下也风生水起，已经聚起了独属于自己的势，而抛开其他不说，玄霄的战力和潜力在域外和本土第一次会谈中，就已经展现出来了。
“域外通道之事，确实，应该再商议！”
玄霄之前一直闭目养神，他感受到了众人目光聚焦在他的身上，然后睁开眼眸轻声说完这句话，又闭上了眼眸。
几大神庭圣地都露出满意的笑容。
将玄霄真正看做是自己人。
玄霄表态之后，众人目光又看向魔尊，这位可是重量级人物，比起玄霄含金量高多了。
这一点无论是从某种表现出来的战力还是目前魔尊所掌控的势力本来说都是这样的。
看到众人目光都聚焦在他身上，魔尊眼神幽暗。
然后平静的说道。
“我赞成关闭通道！”
此话一出，如惊雷炸响，很多域外之人都不可置信的看着魔尊，但也有少部分人，眼神凝重，似乎没有意外。
“魔尊，你可知道你在说什么？你可是我们域外之人，你现在是要与这些土着站在一起吗？”
有人高声质问，说话的人是太初圣地的一位长老。
魔尊是域外之人，所有人都是这么认为的，毕竟魔尊是在域外崛起的，而且现如今很多人认为魔尊便是冥河神子。
content_en:
As the top powers expressed their opinions one after another, everyone else turned their attention to those extraterritorial forces that had not yet expressed their opinions.
The Divine Court of Light and the Divine Court of Destiny remained silent and did not immediately express their attitudes.
Because their situation is much better than that of Taibai Divine Court, Kunxu Divine Court, etc. Daxia's hands cannot reach the northern and southern worlds yet, so everyone's threats cannot currently affect them.
Therefore, they are not as anxious as Taibai Divine Court and Kunxu Divine Court.
"The matter of extraterritorial passage cannot only be decided by the locals of the first ancestral land, and how many people we cross the border is also our own business. The local forces should not have too much control!"
Seeing that everyone's eyes were focused on them, Prince Tianguang of the Destiny Divine Court spoke in a deep voice, expressing the attitude of the Destiny Divine Court.
Although they have great conflicts with other divine courts and other extraterritorial forces, in this first ancestral land, their interests are generally consistent.
They naturally understand the meaning of lips being cold and teeth dying.
"The attitude of the Divine Court of Light is the same as that of the Divine Court of Destiny. We can still sit down and continue talking about some things. It is still inappropriate to directly close the channel."
Princess Galing also spoke on behalf of the Divine Court of Light.
These days, local forces such as Mansion have been in contact with them and even tried to lobby them to help local forces.
The reason is:
Once the extraterritorial channels of the Central Plains World, the Kyushu World and the Shinhwa World are closed, the power of the Taibai Divine Court, the Taichu Holy Land and other large foreign forces in the first ancestral land will be infinitely weakened, and one will decline and the other will rise.
By then, the strength of the Divine Court of Light and the Divine Court of Destiny, which are far away in the north and south, and independently control the extraterritorial passages, will further increase.
This is beneficial to the Divine Court of Light and the Divine Court of Destiny.
This is also the reason why the Divine Court of Light and the Divine Court of Destiny did not take a stand at the beginning.
But obviously, the two great divine courts have now made a decision. They have not betrayed the foreign camp for short-term interests.
Princess Galing's delicate and beautiful face looked serious.
Naturally, there are people in their divine court who are extremely resourceful and have a very far-sighted vision. The voice of rational analysis rang in Princess Galing's ears:
"The closure of the three major world passages is indeed beneficial to us, the Holy Court of Light, in the short term, but in the long term, this is definitely not a good thing for us, the Holy Court of Light. At present, our main conflict is with the local forces in the first ancestral land, and we are only a secondary conflict with other forces such as the Holy Court. If we agree to Daxia now, then we have mistaken the primary and secondary conflicts, and we will definitely suffer a big loss in the future..."
After the Divine Court of Light and the Divine Court of Destiny figured out the primary and secondary conflicts, they immediately made the right decision.
Someone on Daxia's side looked at these two divine courts with deep eyes, and finally stood on their opposite side without any expression of emotion, because winning over these two divine courts was just an idle move. If these two divine courts were really tricked, then after they settled the matter here, the next step would be to directly suck in the northern and southern worlds and get rid of these two stupid divine courts.
After the two great divine courts expressed their stance, everyone looked at Xuan Xiao again.
This person is now very popular in the world of the north and the south, and has gathered his own momentum. Apart from other things, Xuan Xiao's combat power and potential have already been demonstrated in the first meeting between the outside world and the mainland.
"The matter of the extraterritorial passage is indeed something that should be discussed again!"
Xuan Xiao had been keeping his eyes closed before. He felt everyone's eyes focused on him, then he opened his eyes and said this softly, then closed his eyes again.
Several major divine courts and holy places showed satisfied smiles.
Treat Xuan Xiao as one of your own.
After Xuan Xiao made his statement, everyone turned their attention to the Demon Lord. This man was a heavyweight, and his gold content was much higher than that of Xuan Xiao.
This is true regardless of the combat power displayed or the power currently controlled by the Demon Lord.
Seeing that everyone's eyes were focused on him, Demon Lord's eyes were dark.
then calmlysaid.
"I support closing the channel!"
As soon as these words came out, it was like a thunderous explosion. Many people outside the area looked at the Demon Lord in disbelief, but there were also a few people with solemn eyes, as if they were not surprised.
"Demon Lord, do you know what you are talking about? You are from outside our territory. Do you want to stand with these indigenous people now?"
Someone asked loudly, and the person who spoke was an elder from Taichu Holy Land.
Everyone thinks that the Demon Lord is a person from outside the territory. After all, the Demon Lord rose from outside the territory, and many people now believe that the Demon Lord is the Son of God of the River Styx.
